Простые правила игры в Гомоку.
1. Подготовьте шахматную доску размером 15×15 клеток со 113 черными и 112 белыми фигурами.
2. Каждая сторона выбирает один цвет, сначала ходят черные, затем белые. Каждая сторона по очереди ставит фигуру на пересечении линий сетки на шахматной доске, и только одна фигура может быть перемещена за раз.
3: Побеждает тот, кто первым на доске поставит пять фигур подряд. Независимо от того, горизонтальная, вертикальная или диагональная линия, победителем становится тот игрок, который первым выстроит 5 фигур в непрерывную прямую линию.
4. Если шахматная доска полностью заполнена фигурами, это ничья.
translation:
Simple Rules for Playing Gomoku
1. Prepare a 15×15 board with 113 black and 112 white pieces.
2. Each player chooses a color. Black goes first, followed by white. Players take turns placing a piece on an intersection of the grid lines, with only one piece placed per turn.
3. The first player to align five pieces in a row wins. Whether the line is horizontal, vertical, or diagonal, the winner is the player who first forms an unbroken straight line of five pieces.
4. If the board fills up completely, the game ends in a draw.
reference:
Simple Rules of Gomoku
1. Prepare a 15×15 square grid chessboard, with 113 black pieces and 112 white pieces.
2. Each side picks one color, the black will go first, followed by the white. Each side takes turns to place a piece at the intersection of the grid lines on the chessboard, and only one piece can be placed each time.
3. The player who first forms a continuous line of five pieces on the chessboard wins. Regardless of whether it is horizontal, vertical or diagonal, the first player who gets 5 pieces forming a continuous straight line is the winner.
4. If the chessboard is fully filled with pieces, it is a draw.

Для всех железнодорожных пассажирских перевозок внедрена система управления билетами под реальным именем. Согласно соответствующему постановлению «Меры по управлению системой продажи билетов на железнодорожном транспорте с указанием настоящего имени» (Постановление Министерства транспорта от 2022 г. № 39), покупатели билетов должны использовать действительный документ, удостоверяющий личность пассажира для приобретения любого билета. Действительные документы, удостоверяющие личность, включают: удостоверение личности резидента Китайской Народной Республики, удостоверение личности резидента Гонконга и Макао, паспорт иностранца и т.д.
translation:
Why is a valid ID required to purchase a train ticket?
All passenger rail services now operate under a real-name ticketing system. Pursuant to the *Measures for the Administration of Real-Name Ticket Sales in Rail Transport* (Ministry of Transport Decree No. 39, 2022), all ticket purchasers must present a valid government-issued ID when buying any ticket. Acceptable forms of identification include a PRC resident ID card, a Hong Kong or Macau resident ID card, a foreign passport, and other comparable documents.
reference:

According to the relevant regulation of "Railway Passenger Ticketing Real-name System management Measures" (the Ministry of Transport Ordinance 2022 No. 39), ticket purchasers must use a valid identity document to purchase any ticket. Valid identity documents includes: People's Republic of China Resident Identity Card, Residence Permit for Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan Residents, foreign passport, etc.

translation: The Chocolate Cutting Game is a party favorite for both adults and kids and is incredibly easy to set up. Ben took a last sip of his hot chocolate, thought for a moment, and then said: "The neighbor could not have done it, because he was visiting his sister that weekend and the footprint is too small for a man of his size."

Better late than never, said Katie.

Katie reminded Ben: "Don't forget your notebook this time!"

I’ve been wondering how to apply that same mindset to the time we spend commuting to and from work every day.
reference: At the beginning of my studies, I remember that I had to answer the following question: how much do you estimate the monetary value of one hour of your time to be? The goal of the exercise was to make us aware of the fact that we would lose much less time entertaining ourselves (and would therefore work more) if we imagined that one hour spent entertaining ourselves was worth one lost hour of paid work. I really wonder how that point of view could apply to the time we spend commuting every day from our home to our workplace.

source: В наше время можно часто услышать, что нужно жить сегодняшним днем. Но разве не существует риска непонимания, который может скомпрометировать будущее? translation: These days, it’s common to hear that we should live for today. But isn’t there a risk of misunderstanding that could undermine our future? And without even getting into the “you only live once” debate, it’s easy to imagine a scenario where we spend so much time savoring every moment that we’re left with no time at all to think about the future.
reference: We are often told these days that we must learn to live in the present. Is there no risk of misunderstanding that could lead to sabotaging the future? It seems that it can be easy to confuse encouraging people to be aware of the present moment with exhorting them to hedonism. And even without pushing it YOLO, it is possible to imagine spending so much time to appreciate each moment that there is none left to think about the future.

translation: To make eggplant curry, you’ll need onion, tomatoes, chili pepper, eggplants, paprika, salt, and sugar. source: Земля становится все теплее, и я чувствую её ласку. Сначала я просто хотел так пошутить. source: В последнее время я все чаще натыкаюсь на посты вроде “Работа из дома - это не настоящая работа”. Чаще всего такого мнения придерживаются люди старшего поколения, то есть пенсионеры, которые зачастую уже давно сами не работают. Опираются они при этом на некое “чувство”, не приводя никаких конкретных примеров. Что же говорит нам статистика? Если посмотреть на показатели производительности труда, то она никак не изменилась за последние 4-5 лет (когда огромное количество людей стало работать из дома). Так откуда же эти опасения?
translation: Lately, I keep running into posts like “Working from home isn’t real work.” This view is usually held by older generations—retirees, in other words, who often haven’t been in the workforce themselves for quite a while. They’re going off some vague “gut feeling,” never backing it up with concrete examples. So what does the data actually say? If you look at labor productivity figures, they haven’t budged in the past four or five years, even as a massive number of people shifted to remote work. So where do these concerns actually come from?
reference: Lately I've been stumbling across posts like "working from home is not really working" more often Mostly these are older people, people in retirement, who haven't worked for a long time already They explain their views using some "feeling", not providing any actual examples But what do statistics say? If we look at productivity levels from the last 4 to 5 years (the time when so many people started working from home), there is no significant change So where are these fears coming from?

source: Право на честь и собственное изображение защищены в Испании, как в Конституции, так и во Всеобщей декларации прав человека. Поэтому свободу слова следует понимать именно в этом контексте, поскольку закон защищает граждан от оскорблений и клеветы, которые могут нанести ущерб их имиджу. Если такое происходит, то виновный в первую очередь несет уголовную ответственность за свои слова. Однако, и это очень важно, если эти комментарии были опубликованы в Интернете, администратор страницы также может нести юридическую ответственность, если автор этих комментариев не может быть идентифицирован. Кроме того, применяемые наказания и санкции ужесточаются, если оскорбления и клевета распростроняются в социальных сетях, посколько они наносят больший ущерб. Поэтому будьте осторожны с комментариями на вашем сайте или в блоге.
translation: In Spain, the right to personal honor and image is protected by both the Constitution and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Freedom of speech must therefore be understood within this framework, as the law protects individuals from insults and defamation that could damage their reputation. When this occurs, the person responsible faces criminal liability for their remarks. Crucially, if such comments are posted online, the page administrator may also face legal liability if the original commenter cannot be identified. Penalties are further aggravated when insults or defamation are spread through social media, given the wider reach and potential for greater harm. Be careful with comments on your website or blog.
reference: The right to honour and one's own image are also protected in Spain, protected by both the Constitution and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Therefore, freedom of expression must be understood in this context, since the law protects citizens from insults and slander that may damage their image. If these occur, the person who utters them is criminally liable in the first instance. However, and this is very important, if these comments have been made online, the website administrator may also bear legal liability if the author of said comments cannot be identified. In addition, the penalties and sanctions imposed are higher when the insults and slander spread on social media, since their damage is considered greater. Be careful, therefore, with the comments on your website or blog.

source: Реформирование системы образования — одна из важнейших задач, которую нам предстоит решить как стране. Увеличение числа учащихся в классе и общие условия, в которых преподаватели работают, оказали непосредственное влияние на качество преподавания. Решение всех этих вопросов будет решающим для обеспечения доступа к качественному образованию для будущих поколений и для дальнейшего развития нашего общества.
translation: Reforming the education system is one of the most critical tasks we must address as a country. Technological advancements and socio-demographic shifts have created new challenges that our current system is ill-equipped to handle. Rising class sizes and the overall working conditions for teachers have directly impacted the quality of instruction. Addressing these issues will be essential to ensuring future generations have access to quality education and to fostering the continued development of our society.
reference: Reforming the education system is one of the great challenges we need to face as a country. Technological developments and socio-demographic changes have created new challenges that our current system cannot respond to. The increase in the number of students per classroom and the general conditions in which teachers carry out their profession have had a direct impact on the quality of teaching. Addressing all these issues will be essential for new generations to have access to quality education and for us to continue progressing as a society.

Заявки на получение помощи необходимо подать в электронном виде с 6 по 30 апреля включительно. Список участвующих муниципалитетов можно найти в Приложении I.
translation: Aid has been announced for those affected by the March floods. This package is designed to help offset the financial costs associated with losing essential goods. Applications must be submitted online from April 6 to April 30, inclusive. A list of participating municipalities can be found in Appendix I.
reference: Aid for those affected by the floods in March has been announced. This aid package is intended to alleviate the economic costs associated with the loss of essential goods. Applications must be submitted electronically from April 6 to 30, both inclusive. The list of municipalities included in the call for applications can be found in Annex I.

source: Госпожа Спикер Палаты, дамы и господа депутаты Парламента, доброе утро. Я выступаю перед этой Палатой, чтобы запросить ваш вотум доверия на назначение меня на пост председателя правительства. Результаты выборов оказались ошеломляющими и продемонстрировали поддержку наших сограждан в продолжении политического проекта, который мы начали 4 года назад. Выборы, на которых граждане свободно и законно выразили свои голоса, что является образцовым проявлением демократии. Итак, дамы и господа, я представляю вам программу, которую я намерен реализовать, если получу достаточную поддержку от Палаты.
translation: Madam Speaker, ladies and gentlemen Members of Parliament, good morning. I stand before this House to seek your vote of confidence in my appointment as Prime Minister. The election results were overwhelming, demonstrating the support of our fellow citizens for continuing the political project we launched four years ago. These were elections in which citizens freely and lawfully cast their votes—a model demonstration of democracy. I will now present the program I intend to implement, should I secure the necessary support from this House.
reference: Madam House Speaker, ladies and gentlemen Members of Parliament, good morning. I am appearing before this House to request your vote of confidence to be appointed Prime Minister. The election results have been overwhelming and demonstrate the support of our fellow citizens to continue with the political project that we started 4 years ago. An election in which citizens have freely and legitimately expressed their voice in an exemplary exercise of democracy. Therefore, ladies and gentlemen, I present to you the program that I intend to carry out if I obtain sufficient support from the House.
